messages.text: I put the bank envelopes by your laptop. Same Sunday ritual after Mass?
Yes. I want to update the February actuals before Megan calls. Please remind me to leave the 300 row alone this month.
I will defend the 300 row from enthusiasm. Also found Clara's January note in the file drawer.
Good. Once the tabs tie out, I will add the account snapshots for her.
Did you see the new Stephen West clip this morning??? that border is making me sweat already.
Are you still stopping by village hall before knitting tonight??? I can save you the end chair by the outlet.
I saved it during my ten-minute scroll after lunch. The color changes are a lot, but I think the blue-green skeins from Three Bags Full would behave.
Yes. I want to leave a card about the in-home visit rates and the aide turnover before the 4:30 close.
Good. Also Marta asked if you saw the North Branch cleanup signup. She put us down for Saturday morning unless lemon bars count as manual labor.
bring them tonight!!! also I put the lemon bar photo in the group page so Bev stops asking what I'm bringing.
They do not, but I will bring gloves. I also copied the postcard about safe storage for Sue.
I will check that page before I leave. If Sue posted the yardage question there, I missed it.
Found another shoebox from Mom Lewis's basement!!! There are old Evanston Hospital clippings mixed in with Skokie school stuff, of course.
That sounds like my parents' filing system. First half in Evanston folders, everything after sixth grade in Skokie folders.
There is also a blank line on the veterans' plaza form for you. I assume we just leave that one alone and only list Uncle Ray?
Yes, Uncle Ray belongs there. For me, just the library archive contact sheet and the family-tree page with the Polish and German side filled in.
aunt nicole, the receipt email should say $100 and wisconsin at the top. lmk if it landed weird
It came through. I saved the PDF in our tax folder and Daniel saw the charge.
thank you. today was a lot and i am not going to dump details, just glad the fund is getting help.
No details needed. Eat something before your 5:15 person next week, please.
I left the blue 2015 folder by your chair. Can you read me the daily amount after dinner? I want to compare it with the Illinois worksheet.
I see it. The folder has more tabs than my old gradebook, which is not a compliment.
Thanks. The Vanguard and Ally columns look fine. It is the box where both names are checked that keeps making the page ugly.
Then we will look at that box together. After dishes.
Thursday?
Yes. I left the 12:15 slot alone when St. Martha's asked about envelope sorting.
Good. The Cottage, and I am claiming the booth away from the door if no one beats us to it. L
I wrote it in ink weeks ago. Parish envelopes can survive without me until 2.
Thursday? Window booth if it is free. I am bringing the crossword page I mangled. L
Thursday works. I will bring that old LP I told you about, the one with Diamonds & Rust on side A.
Good. We can compare your dramatic side A with my very undramatic tuna melt. L
Fair. I may also put the quiet Nuvole Bianche track on in the car so I arrive less scrambled.
aunt nicole, did you ever finish the wilkerson book or did daniel steal your bookmark again
aunt nicole, did your office ever get one of those outside reps coming around? jess heard from a neighbor who does home visits in evanston that people are comparing notes
Finished it last night. The Chicago chapters are still sitting with me, especially the parts about blocks changing one family at a time.
Not at Comfort at Home. Just talk from other agencies, and even that is in parking lots and kitchens, not on our bulletin board.
yes!! that's the part i wanted you to get to. also sending you the city council packet, but skip the shouty public-comment section lol
that tracks. also i keep thinking about what you said at easter, how seeing aides skip lunch changed your old small-business worry
I will read the practical pages first. Training hours, camera rules, and who gets to review complaints are easier for me to judge than chants.
Ten years ago I would have argued the bookstore owner side first. Then I started watching people do careful work for thin checks, and the old argument stopped fitting.

Found that old family box in Tom's closet!!! There are two framed papers in here, one from your dad with the initials after his name and one from your mom's college. Do you want them before I donate the frames?
Yes, please save them. The gold seal on Dad's always made him so proud, and Mom kept hers right next to her Niles West staff photo.
Saved! Also found a tiny Motorola lapel pin and a Science Club banquet program from 1978. This closet is a museum.
Those two would laugh at being reduced to pins and banquet programs, but yes, keep those too.
Thursday? Same booth if you are bringing the ancient Skokie binder. I found a photo of us in hairnets by the stability-room door. L
Yes, same booth. I am bringing the binder, but only if you promise not to laugh at my October 2009 grid.
The one with hourly numbers, insurance notes, commute times, and your mysterious score in the last column? I have been waiting fifteen years to laugh at that.
It was not mysterious. It kept me from pretending the bigger paycheck automatically won.
I found that old Skokie lab badge photo. You look exhausted in it, which tracks with those after-work Dempster drives you were making. L
That was the stretch when I kept a change of shoes in the trunk. Lab coat off, Skokie bag in hand.
Same look you had in 2017 with the phone permanently on the kitchen counter. Different parent, same clipboard energy.
The clipboards saved me. I still have the mileage notebook and Dad's nurse-call sheets in the basement box.
Thursday? Window booth if you can get there before the lunch crowd. L
I am coming from Mr. Tanaka's and need ten extra minutes. The agency tablet is stuck spinning on his vitals screen.
Of course you are the person trying to make a small machine behave before soup.
I promised myself I would not leave blanks today. Mrs. K's September paperwork taught me that lesson.
Running late from Skokie. Janet kept us for the new March forms, and Maria found the old coffee mug I left in the break room cabinet.
I will keep dinner warm. The mug has apparently had a more stable weekday routine than most adults.
Kayla laughed at the 2011 photo on my badge again. I told her she can tease me after she survives one full winter schedule.
Fair standard. I put Winston's leash by the back door.
Margaret called the house line. She said your TurboTax draft opened fine, but she wants the Chase PDF with the travel credit page.
I saved it under 2025/Lewis return/Chase. Tell her I will resend from the desktop after Winston eats.
Also, the card notice says the March statement amount will pull on the 18th. Not the smaller number, naturally.
Good. I only need that one autopay left alone while she checks the draft.
The kitchen is closed, Winston has been out, and your phone is charging by the lamp.
Thank you. I am doing the 15-minute Calm one and then I want the room dark by 10.
I will keep the television at library volume. This is apparently not an official unit, but it should be.
Perfect. If I am up at 5:30, I can walk him before the rain starts.
I have lemon bars cooling and a 9x13 I can spare if your St. Martha's drop-off still needs dessert!!!
Perfect. The Harrises have two teenagers, so dessert will not go to waste. I am writing the note after dinner.
You're good at those notes. Just enough heart, not Hallmark syrup.
That's the aim. Food, a few lines, and no speeches.
Sunday still your place?? Tom says he can grab wine after we come back from the Glenview Jewel.
Yes. Come for 3 if that works. I am starting the roast so we can eat around 5.
Perfect!! We'll leave here about 2:40. Also Mark's red envelope came, Phoenix stamp and all. Do you want me to bring it?
Bring it. I will put it with the card box after dessert.
Thinking of you today!! Fridays must still feel odd without that stop.
They do. I parked by the old Walgreens lot for a minute instead of going straight to lunch.
Did you keep the card with you? The one with the little pine tree?
Yes, inside pocket of my work bag. Daniel packed the last stew jar too, so I am covered.
Do you want me to ask Tom to scan that old bleacher picture for the June thing?? The one where Dan has actual hair 😂
Yes, please. I found the ticket sleeve but not the photo copy. It was tucked behind the cake receipt last time.
Of course it was!!! You two and your filing system from 1991.
That system got us this far. Tell Tom I only need the scan, not commentary on the score.
I found my old note from the Park Ridge needle place. Mine was 2022, not 2021. Did you say you tried that twice?
Once in 2019 and again in 2022. It helped a little, mostly the next day, but not enough to become a whole routine.
That sounds about right. Also, skip the aisle with the miracle-joint bottles. Half of them read like late-night television. L
Agreed. I am sticking with the two bottles Dr. K said were harmless enough, and saving my patience for stairs.
Thursday at The Cottage still works. Also, I found that article about bloom timing you mentioned. Your April-row system may need a weather column. L.
Still works. And yes, I added a column after last month's bank line posted. Daniel laughed at the color coding.
If the colors keep you from moving the number twice, keep them. I say this as someone who once paid ComEd twice in one week. L.
aunt nicole, can i steal your template for the monthly money thing? jess and i keep getting ambushed by car tags and vet stuff 😭
I will send a blank copy. The trick is one steady 300 line that waits for exactly those things.
that is annoyingly calm. does daniel actually sit through all the tabs with you?
He does. Once a month, coffee beside him, calculator beside me.
aunt nicole can i borrow your sunday planning template? mine is chaos and i need boxes to put things in 😵‍💫
Of course. Mine has meals, calls, errands, and a small 'what can wait' column. That last one keeps me from treating everything like a fire.
literally need that column. also did you ever find the name of the dr you saw for a few weeks after grandma died? no pressure, just curious how you picked someone.
I found the file. Six Wednesdays in 2011, Dr. Mercer on Touhy. I chose by location and whether she sounded calm on the phone.
You already out with the field glasses or am I too early???
Just leaving Harrer now. Winston got his full outside edge, and I have my scope in the car.
of course you do!!! save me if you see a good egret photo later.
If the pond corner is quiet again, I will send one before I head to the 8:45 meet-up.
Did the blue tote survive another Saturday? I found two bottles of glitter glue in my car if Diane is desperate 😂
Barely. We ran out of purple yarn before the 11:00 craft table, and Diane gave me that look over her glasses.
That look is POWERFUL!!! Are you going straight home or doing your Saint Martha's stop?
Saint Martha's first. Father James said he could spare ten minutes before the 2:30 appointment.
are you and daniel doing village hall before knitting tuesday or after?? i can save your chair if you are late!!!
Before, if the line is not ridiculous. I printed our pages and Daniel put the IDs by the keys.
of course he did 😂 also i saw that clip you mentioned, the one where Durbin pushed back on his own side. send it again?
I will. It is why I keep saving those floor clips even when they are dry as toast.
Tom is bringing two bottles tonight!! One Chianti and one of those Oregon pinots he thinks makes him fancy.
Tell him Daniel and I will share the pinot with dinner. I had my little printout from Dr. Rao this week and the numbers were pleasantly dull.
Dull is GOOD. Also Mark asked if anyone wants cigars on the patio after dessert, which, no thank you from me.
Same here. I will stay inside with coffee and the dishes while the patio people freeze.
I am stuck on 32 Across and blaming you preemptively. Did Daniel already head downtown?
I finished while the oatmeal cooled. Daniel left on the 8:42 and promised not to spend the whole morning in the Monet rooms.
Saturday smugness noted. Tell him the trains are still cheaper than parking near those lions. L
aunt nicole did you ever get the paperwork thing after that scope last fall? mom is asking because she lost hers 🙃
Mine is in the NorthShore folder with the September Dr. Patel sheet. I can scan the page that says when to come back.
perfect. also mom wants to know if they made you stop the little 81 one before it
Yes, briefly. I wrote the exact dates on a sticky note because I do not trust myself with those instructions.
I have the BMO page open for our first-Sunday arithmetic. My TRS entry is still 3,800 and change.
Good. Mine only had one Friday so far this month, so I penciled the second one for the 20th before adding your tutoring checks.
Two students paid already. That puts the March side envelope near 500 unless Maya cancels again.
Then the month should land near our usual 7,500 before I split groceries, escrow, and Kyoto.
I put the dishes away. Your 7:30 block is clear, and Winston has already accepted his bribe.
Thank you. Tonight is the GCM ethics module, then I need twenty minutes with the shadow-shift notes from Friday.
That sounds like a full lesson plan. Retired teachers recognize the signs.
I want the next person walking into a new house to have more than scraps and memory. The office is starting to ask for my version.
Did you and Megan get your screen time last Sunday?? She said Jess waved from the kitchen and then vanished!
We did. Jess was making soup. Megan looked tired but perked up when Daniel asked about the balcony herbs.
She told me the Tuesday person is helping her leave the courthouse stories at the door, thank heaven.
I am glad she is keeping that time. I also told her the Wisconsin receipt is filed, so she can stop checking on me.
Do you still have that little photo album from the first spring on Austin Ave?? The one with the tiny puppy on the green kitchen floor!
Yes. Same drawer as the 1997 house papers. Daniel labeled it, naturally.
Of course he did 😂 Was that May 1998? I want to show Megan the picture of you two holding the leash like you had no idea what you were doing.
May 1998. We had Winston's predecessor for about three weeks and already rearranged the back room around the crate.
I found the little maple-print scarf from Stowe while looking for my good gloves. Made me think of your albums.
That was the same shelf as the vineyard map and the castle postcards. Daniel says my filing system is just piles with confidence.
He is not wrong. Bring the Cannon Beach photos Thursday if you still have them sorted by date. I want to see the one with the wet shoes. L
I do, because those five September workdays were the only ones that got their own envelope.
I moved the little blue booklet back to your chair. It was under the Tribune.
Thank you. I had three quiet minutes before Winston started pawing at the door.
He respects no one else's schedule, earthly or otherwise.
I will stop by St. Martha's on Dempster after Mrs. Ito and leave the sympathy cards.
I can do dishes and Winston after dinner. Your 7:30 square is still on the wall calendar.
Thank you. I have the March packet open already, plus two saved pieces from that Friday send.
Understood. I will keep the house from becoming a case example.
Good. Tonight is intake questions and what to ask adult children before the first visit.
Do you want me to remind Bev about the $18 before tomorrow, or are you already doing your tidy little numbers sheet? !!!
I have Bev at $18 and Marta at $12 from the spring restock. I will bring the pouch with the cash and slips.
Perfect. Also Ellen says preseason seats are cheaper if we put 6 together before Friday.
Ask her to hold off until I see everyone at 6:30 tomorrow. I want clean numbers before anyone sends money twice.
You disappeared from the crossword board yesterday. I assume either Daniel fed you or Spielberg won. L
Both. Beef stew, then Schindler's List. I only made it to 28 Across.
That is a heavy choice for a Sunday, but I know you have your stack.
I do. The same few films go back on when my hands need something familiar to fold laundry around.
aunt nicole, mom asked if she actually needs the new arm-stick thing this year or if that was just facebook being dramatic 🙃
Tell Karen I would rather look at Dr. Patel's note and the CDC chart before I answer. Mine was logged after the January appointment, but I want the wording right.
perfect. she also sent me a youtube link and i immediately thought: not for aunt nicole lol
You know me. If Mayo has a plain-language page, send that instead and I will call her after dinner.
Village hall lot is half full. I am in the north row, two spaces from the maple.
I am turning off Dempster now. I have both sample sheets and the judicial notes.
Good. You highlighted nearly the same column all the way down again. The one exception is circled twice.
That exception earned it. Meet you by the side door.
did you put the yarn restock on your magic travel card again??? i can venmo my $38 tonight!!!
Yes, I used the same one. Easier for the spreadsheet, and the receipt went into my March folder.
you and your folders. remind me, are you still trying to get everything to Margaret before the weekend?
Yes. TurboTax is basically done, but she catches the things I miss.
Are you still coming tonight? I saved the chair by the pattern books and the lemon bars are behaving for once!!!
I will be there at 6:30. Tuesday yarn time and Linda's Thursday lunches are the two boxes I try hardest not to disturb.
Excellent. I respect a woman with immovable boxes on her calendar.
It is the only way anyone actually sees anyone once everyone has knees, errands, and opinions.
Is Daniel still doing those kitchen-table numbers with Evan on Tuesdays?? Megan said his color-coded pages saved her once too 😂
Yes, 4:15 today. I moved the grocery run earlier and left the dining room cleared.
Good!! He sounds so much more himself with a pencil in his hand than he did that first fall home.
It helps. He has Evan, then dishes while I finish the budget sheet after dinner.
I put the blue mat and the thicker pad by the back door. Left side looked stiff when you came in from Winston's walk.
Thank you. Right side is still calmer than before February, so I will take the small victory.
Do you want me to drive you to the Senior Center tonight? Dempster is already slow.
Yes, please. I need to eat first so the fish oil does not argue with me halfway through class.
i forgot to send the shawl photo!!! are you still looking at patterns tonight or did i lose you to your 10:00 shutdown?
Send it now. I have until about 9:40 before I start the Calm timer.
sent. also i need your discipline because i would still be rearranging yarn at midnight.
Discipline or age. Either way, the 5:30 alarm wins.
aunt nicole do you still salt the eggplant first or am i inventing that??
Salt it in the colander for 30 minutes, then pat it dry. Do the zucchini coins after that so everything stays in order.
literal court brain cannot handle vegetable choreography today 😭 also jess asked if your saturday blueberry thing has the crumbly oat top
It does. Cold butter, oats, and a small scoop of the vanilla bean on top while it is still warm.
omg my windowsill basil is already dramatic. did yours come up yet?
Tomatoes are just showing. Peppers are taking their sweet time. I need more potting mix after my quick Mariano's stop tomorrow.
classic peppers. also remind me when the village hall saturday thing starts, jess wants to come with me sometime this summer
Usually June. I will check the notice board when I am over there next.
The $200 transfer cleared. Do you want me to mark the bank site, or are you already inside the file?
Already in it. The separate line is at $4,200 now, assuming no typo in my formula.
I checked your arithmetic. It survives cross-examination. The 40th column still looks ambitious, but not absurd.
Are you still coming Tuesday or did Janet steal you for another Skokie meeting???
Still coming. Maria swapped her afternoon so I can make 6:30, and Kayla is taking the late check-in after I show her the note format.
Bless Maria. Also you teaching Kayla your tidy-note ways explains EVERYTHING 😂
She asked for my old laminated checklist. Janet said it has survived more chart audits than some filing cabinets.
Is Dan taking the train in today?? Tom says the Van Gogh thing is still up!!
Yes, I put the Ventra card by his keys. I am bringing the 9x9 book for my ride after I finish the little black-and-white grid with coffee.
Of course you have TWO grids before most people find their shoes 😂
Only one before shoes. The number one waits until the conductor punches through after Clybourn.
Megan sent me that hearing link!! Is this the one you said starts at 1? I can listen while shelving books maybe
Yes, 1:00. The first panel is about the waiver backlog and why agencies cannot keep weekend aides.
Ok good. Also Tom found your little card on the dining table about background checks and the 72 hour wait. Was that for us or did I steal homework?
Not stolen. I was leaving it with the seed packets for Sunday in case you wanted to mail one too.
For Sunday, are you still doing roast chicken?? Also remind me how many days you can be off this year, I am comparing notes with our school calendar!!!
Two weeks total for me. I used three days around Mr. Henderson's service, so I am guarding the rest for June.
That sounds like us, except I lose track because part-time makes everything weird. Did you ever take their medical add-on?
No, I stayed on Daniel's card. They still put the smaller allowance line in my paperwork, but it was not worth switching.
Thursday? Window booth if we get there before the church ladies claim it. L
Yes. I already put Cottage, 11:30, window booth, and no errands after into the March sheet.
You and your sheets. Still, they did get you through that ugly year after your mother, so I will stop teasing.
Tease away. The sheet plus those Wednesday appointments kept the floor under me.
Thursday? I can do The Cottage at 12:15 if you do not mind the window booth.
Perfect. I may bring the folder I mentioned, just to show you the daily-rate page. No news talk, I promise.
Bring it. I still have the numbers from when we priced help for Mom, and I remember the sticker shock. L.
That is the phrase. Our regular accounts are behaving, which somehow makes this one page stand out more.
Thursday? I can bring the scanner wand if you still have those old family forms. Mine is behaving for once. L
Yes, please. I have the Evanston baptism copy, the Skokie address card from when we moved, and my parents' anniversary photo from the old living room.
Any brothers or sisters sending extra boxes, or is this all still coming from your closets?
Just my closets. Daniel found a form asking for unit and discharge dates, so that page is easy: nothing to enter.
Thursday? Cottage at 12:45. I am ordering fries and refusing comment from the medical establishment. L
Thursday works. I am bringing the little card from my appointment because you will appreciate how boring 118/76 looks in black ink.
Boring numbers deserve fries. Are you doing your usual one glass at dinner after, or are we pretending iced tea is festive?
Tea at lunch, one glass at dinner. Wild woman.
Karen called while you were out. She says Tom left his corkscrew here last Sunday.
I found it under the sideboard. They can get it when they come on the 22nd.
Reasonable. Also, Mark's card is on my desk. I wrote three lines and ran out of annual news.
Three lines is plenty. Add the photo from Megan's visit and I will address the Phoenix envelope.
The schedule is out. First home night we can reasonably do is April 10, assuming your knees approve of the upper deck.
Upper deck is fine if you do not make me climb like we did in 1989.
That climb had consequences. Some of them lasted.
Put two seats in the cart. Same side of town, lower stairs, and no arguing about keeping score.
Are you still bringing the lemon yarn Tuesday or did Dr. P steal your whole week again??
He only gets one September morning. This week was just Walgreens and the usual little bottles.
Good!!! I need your help counting the spring restock money before I mess it up.
I will bring the envelope and the shawl. Remind me not to leave the D3 bottle in the car again.
Your lunch story about the agency folder stayed with me. A single page surviving actual field use is rarer than a clean audit. L
High praise from QA. I only changed the sequence because Maria kept reaching for the vitals box before asking about breakfast.
Sequence matters. You know this. If they ever let you write the whole intake-to-night-note path, make them pay you in real money.
First I finish the 18-month course plan. Then I can make a better case than 'Nicole has opinions.'
aunt nicole did you ever find the calm track from that movie night playlist? jess asked after dinner
I think you mean Experience. I tucked it between The Night They Drove Old Dixie Down and Divenire.
yes!! literally that one. send me the whole order when you can?
I will. It is a very odd order, but it works while I am winding yarn.
I put the craft tote by the back door. No bingo cards in it, unless they are hiding under the felt.
Thank you. Diane only needs me for sorting today, not calling numbers. I should be done before lunch.
Good. Father James left a message on the house phone. He said there is no hurry, but he will be in his office after noon.
I will call him from the parking lot if the morning runs long.
I am at Walgreens for Winston's pill pockets. Do you want me to ask them to reprint the page with your October and January entries?
Yes, please. The portal has flu and COVID in October, and Dr. Patel added the January line, but the pharmacy printout is easier for my folder.
Understood. I will avoid asking the teenager at the register for a grand unified theory of respiratory season.
Thank you. The VIS sheet and Dr. Patel's message are enough grand theory for me.
I put the tide table printout in the binder. September 18 has the coffee receipt stapled to it, for reasons known only to you.
That was the morning you insisted we could beat the rain if we left Yachats before 8.
A poor theorem, disproved by both of our shoes.
Leave that page with the December week sheet. I need both clean copies before payroll asks for old records.
Sample sale is dangerous today!!! I am leaving before I buy gray yarn I do not need.
Wise. I am stopping for ricotta and crushed tomatoes, then I need the red pan filled before two.
Big layered pan day? Respect. Also I saw blueberries by the checkout and thought of your Saturday pan.
Already in the cart, with the little vanilla bean carton Daniel likes.
Do you still have that binder template?? The one with tabs for visitors, meds, calls, all of it!! Megan says I should make one before Mom's stuff gets messy.
I can bring copies Sunday. I used the first version for my mother's Skokie schedule, then rebuilt it for Dad in 2017.
You had those color-coded pages, right? I remember Daniel saying you were driving there after work almost every other day.
Three or four nights some weeks. Dad's version was more phone calls than driving, but the same kitchen-table command center.
Thursday lunch still on? I am declaring the window booth before the hostess gives it to someone loud. L
Still on. I may come in wound up after our Skokie meeting. We had another round of "this is just how the budget works" about weekend coverage.
You used to sound like the owner of that tiny lab whenever pay rules came up. Now you sound like the people clocking the weekends. Interesting evolution.
The lab was different. In homes, when one aide takes two clients and still worries about groceries, I have trouble repeating my old lines.
aunt nicole, mom found the old Rush envelope in her basement and asked if you wanted it back before she shreds stuff
If it is the 1994-1998 one, yes. I keep that with the adoption receipt from the pup we brought home that May.
got it. also she says there is a handwritten note from you and uncle daniel on the back that just says 'enough appointments.' very your handwriting.
That sounds right. Put it in your bag for Sunday if you come down; Daniel and I will be here after Winston's supper.
Pancakes are done. I also put air in the tires before the rain starts.
Thank you. I booked Winston's Tuesday shot appointment and put the receipt in the budget folder.
I have Priya at 11 with the quadratic packet, then the library shelves from 2 to 5. A glamorous circuit.
I'll do lunches and the garden trays while you're out.
Are you bringing the old family photos Tuesday??? The group loved the one with your mom in the white coat and those kids holding petri dishes.
I can bring that one. I also found Dad in a short-sleeve shirt with five men around a workbench in Schaumburg, all of them looking very serious about a little black box.
Perfect. Mine are just bad perms and prom dresses. Yours have props!!!
Tom says if you and Daniel are still doing 9:30 at St Martha's we can come at 3 instead of 2!!!
3 is better. I need to check the office basket first; the Sheehan boys need gift cards more than another lasagna.
Oh those poor boys. Tell me what amount and I'll add one too ❤️
$25 is plenty. I will put both in one envelope so their aunt does not have to track names.
Is this the wild shawl guy you showed me?? I saw your heart on his striped one and knew it had to be yours!!!
Yes, Stephen West. I only opened the app to see Aunt Ruth's birthday photos and got pulled into those stripes.
Of course you did 😂 Bring yours Sunday? Mine still looks like a potholder with ambition.
I will bring it. I am on the section with the tiny repeats, so do not let Tom put gravy anywhere near my bag.
Thursday at The Cottage still works. Also, please do not bring the whole village packet unless you promise not to make me read footnotes before soup. L
No packet at lunch. I only copied two pages because they reminded me of the route maps in that big migration book Megan gave me.
Two pages is still a packet in disguise.
Fair. I am mostly trying to separate the actual proposals from the loud signs. Cameras, training time, and a resident panel sound worth discussing.
Do you want my extra plant markers?? I bought too many again!!
Yes, bring them Sunday. I labeled tomatoes and zucchini but ran out before the herbs.
Perfect. Also are you doing that village hall stop this year? I may tag along once my Saturdays calm down.
If they keep the same June start, yes. I like to go early and be done before the heat.
aunt nicole, can i send you karen's knee questions later or is your nightly school-ish hour sacred? 😬
Send them before 7 if you can. From 7:30 to 8:30 I am trying to stay honest with the January group.
lol respect. also that link you forwarded about home stairs was actually useful, shocking
It came in the Monday batch from the portal. I only forward the practical ones.
The credit-card line posted: WI online giving, $100. I put it under March charitable.
Thank you. Megan sent the link after our Sunday call, so that category makes sense.
Good. Also, remind her not to answer messages from that building after dinner. Her aunt may phrase it more diplomatically.
I will ask on the next first Sunday. Jess may back me up.
Ellen dropped an envelope through the mail slot. It says six seats and has a sticky note about section 352.
That is for the ladies from Northbrook. Please put it by my blue pouch, not with the household bills.
Done. The pouch is getting more organized than my tutoring folders.
It has to. I still need to match Gail's Venmo against Marta's cash from last Tuesday.
Did Dr. K say you could still do the Wednesday class?? I was thinking of trying something slow but my stairs are making me cranky today 😬
He said the slow class is fine if I use the wall and skip the deep bends. I am bringing the extra pad again.
Okay good!! Also tell me which yellow capsules you buy. Megan sent me a link that sounds too good to be real.
I use the plain turmeric one from Costco. If the label promises a brand-new body, I put it back.
Megan asked if you still have that old worksheet you made when you left the Skokie place!! She is doing the same kind of pro/con thing.
